cohort: The study included 106 children aged 8-12 years with a diagnosis of atopic dermatitis, comprising both genders.
finding: A significant majority of patients with atopic dermatitis had a history of asthma, allergic rhinitis, and antibiotic use in their first year of life.
mod_finding: Among the children with atopic dermatitis, 68 were born by caesarean section and 38 by normal vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected when the children were aged 8-12 years.
